title: Pattern-library entry
description: A pattern-library entry, governed like code: owner and second-person approver, version history, review date, discriminators, invalidation triggers, reversal threshold and the machine-close flag.

name.description: Name (one line: the benign behavior this documents)

owner.description: Owner (person or team accountable for the entry's correctness)

approver.description: A second person, not the author or requester.

versionAndWhatChanged.x-assured-prompt: Version, and what changed from the previous version
versionAndWhatChanged.description: Version, and what changed from the previous version

reviewDate.description: Review date (the entry's expiry: invalid for Level 0 after this date; by default every 90 days)

theThreatItMimics.description: The threat it mimics (what the detection is actually hunting)

linkedDetections.description: Linked detections (rule name and ID @ version) this pattern typically fires

expectedVolume.description: Expected volume (closes per week, and the host or identity spread), and the threshold above which a spike forces review

evidenceBasis.description: Evidence basis (the cases, vendor documentation, or change records that established the behavior as benign)

howAnAttackerWould.x-assured-prompt: How an attacker would imitate this pattern, and which discriminator still catches the imitation
howAnAttackerWould.description: How an attacker would imitate this pattern, and which discriminator still catches the imitation

validationTest.description: Validation test (how to generate an imitation the discriminators must catch; run it at each review)

blindSpots.description: Blind spots (what these discriminators cannot see)

recurrenceThreshold.description: Recurrence threshold (e.g. three Level 0 closes on the same entity in seven days force a Level 1 review)

invalidationTriggers.description: Invalidation triggers (any of these forces immediate re-review; closes move to Level 1 meanwhile): linked rule changed, asset group re-tagged, observed abuse of the pattern, and for AI-matched entries a model, prompt or tool version change; other

reversalThreshold.description: Reversal threshold (confirmed false closes that suspend the entry automatically until the owner re-reviews it; by default, one)

machineCloseFlag.description: Machine-close flag (default off). Turn it on only when every box holds

qaSampleRateForMachineCloses.x-assured-prompt: QA sample rate for machine closes

rate.description: Share of machine closes a human reviews, or "not applicable" while the flag is off.

qaSampleRateForMachineCloses.description: QA sample rate for machine closes (share of closes a human reviews, and the reviewer; "not applicable" while the flag is off)

thisEntry.x-assured-checkbox: this entry, at this version, carries the flag with the approver's sign-off

discriminatorsAreEvaluatedByCode.x-assured-checkbox: discriminators are evaluated by code, not by a reader

theEligibilityGateIsEnforced.x-assured-checkbox: the eligibility gate is enforced by code on every close

humansQaSampleTheMachine.x-assured-checkbox: humans QA-sample the machine closes (rate and reviewer named)

reversalAndMissRatesAre.x-assured-checkbox: reversal and miss rates are tracked for this entry

aKillSwitchExists.x-assured-checkbox: a kill switch exists, with a named owner

alertsClosedAgainstThis.description: Alerts closed against this entry (running count or query link)

auditSampleResults.description: Audit-sample results (date, closes sampled, false closes found)

falseCloseReviews.description: False-close reviews (date and outcome, when a close against this entry was later found wrong)

versionHistory.description: Version history (version, date, author, approver, change)
